items.q: How much does hot tub removal cost in East Gwillimbury?

items.q: What happens to the hot tub after it's removed?
a: Metal frame components and the motor or pump go to recyclers; the shell, foam and cabinet are disposed of responsibly.

items.q: Do you handle removal on farms between the hamlets?
a: Yes — the concessions between communities are regular work for us, priced the same flat way as a hamlet or corridor job.

items.q: Is it safe to remove a hot tub that's still wired to electrical?
a: Only once the power is confirmed off. A hardwired 240V connection needs prior disconnection by a licensed electrician.

items.q: Can you remove a hot tub the same day I call?
